how.title: How this is worked out
how.window_one: Only the last {{count}} full day of this baby's log; today is not counted.
how.window_other: Only the last {{count}} full days of this baby's log; today is not counted.
how.evening: A night belongs to the evening it started on; the day starts at {{time}}.
how.nightBounds: Nights shorter than {{min}} or longer than {{max}} are left out.
how.minimumNights_one: A sleep figure needs at least {{count}} night.
how.minimumNights_other: A sleep figure needs at least {{count}} nights.
how.minimumDays_one: Naps and feeds per day need at least {{count}} day.
how.minimumDays_other: Naps and feeds per day need at least {{count}} days.
how.minimumGaps_one: The time between feeds needs at least {{count}} gap; gaps over {{max}} are left out.
how.minimumGaps_other: The time between feeds needs at least {{count}} gaps; gaps over {{max}} are left out.
how.varies: Bed time and wake-up show "Varies" when they spread by more than {{spread}}.
how.ranges: A range is the middle half of the nights or days, with the median.
how.eveningFeeds: Evening feeds are the feeds in the {{window}} before bed time.
how.groups_one: A comparison needs {{count}} night on each side and a difference of at least {{difference}}, larger than the usual night-to-night spread.
how.groups_other: A comparison needs {{count}} nights on each side and a difference of at least {{difference}}, larger than the usual night-to-night spread.
how.describes: A comparison only describes the log: it does not say why nights differ.
